name: Battle

components.pose: She stands with her storm conduit rod thrust skyward in one hand and the other arm flung out, hair lifted by static, a fierce, exhilarated gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: A fork of white-hot lightning strikes her rod and arcs outward across the field, standing stones flaring, static crackling over her armour in {{MAGIC}} light.

notes: BATTLE: the sister in class-aligned war gear commanding her element on a battlefield of her homeland. Reuses her signature weapon.
